rounds.text: Ansal Housing is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.36x [E2] and a P/E ratio of 3.58 [E1]. This valuation is starkly disconnected from the sector benchmark, where the company’s P/B of 0.41x sits far below the sector’s 6.2x [E7]. Recent operational momentum suggests a turnaround, as profit growth is now outpacing 1-year price growth by 380% [E56], supported by YoY profit growth exceeding 20% [E67]. While long-term sales growth has been inconsistent, the company has demonstrated a capacity for recovery with 16% compounded sales growth over the last five years [E15] and recent quarter-over-quarter sales increases [E68]. Conceded: [E4], [E5], [E14], [E17], [E70], and [E71]. The current market capitalisation of ₹ 43.1 Cr [E3] fails to reflect the company's ability to outperform expectations through fundamental improvements [E56].
